name: Ivan Zhang
title: Co-founder @ Cohere
bio: Ivan Zhang is a co-founder at Cohere, the security-first enterprise AI company. At Cohere, Ivan oversees key technical product development and is closely involved in the company’s public sector and government customers. Prior to co-founding Cohere alongside Aidan Gomez and Nick Frosst, Ivan foundedfor.ai(now Cohere Labs). Ivan also worked in biotech and MLOps space as a software engineer and studied at the University of Toronto.

name: Olivia Markham
title: Member of Technical Staff, Reasoning @ Cohere
bio: Olivia studied Mechatronics Engineering at the University of Waterloo before moving into the AI field. She's spent the past two years on Cohere's core post-training team working on synthetic data and reasoning models.

name: Eugene Cho
title: Member of Technical Staff @ Cohere
bio: As a machine learning engineer, Eugene has worked on various aspects of training large language models at scale. He previously worked on the synthetic data team, where he was involved in developing scalable data pipelines for both LLM pre-training and post-training. His focus then shifted to the emerging reasoning language model paradigm, where he helped advance internal research on reinforcement learning training techniques, infrastructure and data. Currently, his main area of work is centered around optimizing LLMs for agentic cybersecurity usecases.

name: Sepideh Shaterian
title: Member of Technical Staff @ Cohere
bio:
Sepideh Shaterian is a Member of Technical Staff (MTS) Performance Engineer on the Pretraining team at Cohere, where she works on optimizing large-scale foundation models and LLM training. Her role focuses on improving training efficiency, scalability, and system-level performance across distributed environments, enabling faster and more reliable development of state-of-the-art language models.

Previously, Sepideh worked at AMD, gaining experience in performance-critical systems and AI compilers. She holds a Master's degree from the University of Waterloo, where her research focused on Image Compression for Computer Vision applications.

Sepideh's technical interests include LLM pretraining, performance optimization, efficient AI systems, and bridging research with production-scale infrastructure.
